name: feedback_id
description: Primary key. One row per review.

name: business_id
description: Stable identifier of the reviewed business. STR-nnn joins to AlloyDB stores.store_id; CMP-nnn is a competitor with no operational record. Join on this, never on business_name.

name: business_name
description: Display name of the reviewed business. Presentation only: not unique and not stable.

name: business_type
description: 'own_store' or 'competitor'. Filter on this before drawing conclusions about this brand.

name: review_date
description: Date the review was posted, within 180 days of the anchor date.

name: tone
description: Sentiment label that steers AI.GENERATE when writing review_text. Scaffolding, not an observed field.

name: topic
description: Subject the review should discuss. Scaffolding, not an observed field.
